documentation.file_docstring: OWASP Agentic Security Initiative (ASI) 2026 — risk catalogue. Reference: https://genai.owasp.org/agentic-security-initiative/ Catalogue: https://genai.owasp.org/agentic-risk/ Migrated from legacy LLM Top-10 "ATxx" identifiers to the 2026 ASI taxonomy ("ASIxx"). A backward-compatible lookup is provided so that existing code referencing AT IDs continues to work.
inline_comments: Backward-compatible mapping from legacy LLM Top-10 "AT" identifiers to the primary ASI 2026 identifier.  Where a legacy ID maps to multiple ASI risks, the first entry is the primary match.
Resolve a risk ID to its canonical ASI identifier. Returns the ID unchanged if it already starts with "ASI", or maps it via {@link LEGACY_AT_TO_ASI} if it is a legacy "AT" ID.
Return OWASP risk objects for a list of risk IDs. Accepts both ASI 2026 IDs (e.g. "ASI01") and legacy AT IDs (e.g. "AT01"). Unknown IDs are silently skipped.
Format OWASP risk references as a Markdown list.
